props.name: children
props.description: Rendered once the wrapper comes within `rootMargin` of the viewport.

props.name: rootMargin
props.description: How far outside the viewport to start mounting, as an IntersectionObserver root margin.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Space held before mount, so the page does not jump when the content arrives. Number is px.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio held before mount — `16 / 9` — for media whose height follows its width.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the reserved space until mount. Defaults to a quiet sunken block.

props.name: unmountWhenHidden
props.description: Unmount again when scrolled far away, keeping the last measured height. For very long pages.

props.name: onMount
props.description: Called each time the children mount.
